text:
Mia L: Quick thread — I want to assemble a concise customer-facing runbook (one page + appendix) that covers streaming, client-side batching, and cache priming for new accounts. Goal: reduce renewal risk in the first 0–30 days and give CS/eng a clear handoff. Ideas?

Omar R: Love this. Keep the main doc entirely non-technical, then an "Appendix: Tech snippets" for engineers. Include explicit prefill guidance (top 5 prompts per tenant) and a recommended off-peak prefill window.

Jun Park: Agree. Also include a tiny SDK example for batching and a streaming fallback pattern. Customers like copy-paste examples.

Sofia A: Add telemetry checkpoints to the runbook: baseline 95th latency, cost-per-1k tokens, error rates. Recommend SLOs and a simple escalation path (CS -> Solutions Eng -> Eng-oncall).

Mia L: Draft outline I'm thinking of:
- Why this matters (cost, latency, renewal signals)
- Quick setup for non-engineers (checkboxes)
- Client batching: recommended defaults + tradeoffs
- Streaming: when to enable vs poll/long-poll
- Cache priming: prefix strategy, TTL guidance, prefill cadence
- Rollout checklist + 14-day health check
- Appendix: SDK snippets, alert templates, template survey
Does that look right?

Omar R: Add a one-line "what to tell execs" section: 3 simple metrics (avg response time, cost per 1k requests, top failure reason) they can share in renewals.

Jun Park: Sample snippet for appendix:
```js
// batch helper (pseudo)
await client.batchGenerate([{prompt: p1},{prompt: p2}], {batchSize: 4, maxTokens: 256})
```
Streaming fallback pseudo-rule: `if (p95_latency_ms > 250) { enableStreaming = true }`

Sofia A: For enablement coordination: propose two customer-facing calls — 1) Tech walkthrough during onboarding, 2) 14-day health check to review metrics and renewal signals. Capture action items in the runbook.

Mia L: Who can own the customer feedback capture checklist? I want a tiny survey (3 questions) + a short eval prompt set we can run automatically.

Omar R: I can own the survey. Draft: 1) NPS line, 2) a checkbox for "feature pain" (streaming/batching/cost), 3) "Did streaming improve UX?" (yes/no) + optional free text. Keep it under 3 taps.

Jun Park: I'll write the SDK examples and the cache priming section (what to prefill, how many queries, recommended off-peak windows).

Sofia A: I'll create the telemetry dashboard template and a starter alert rule: `error_rate > 2% for 5m -> page oncall` and a CS ticket escalation note.

Deploy Bot: draft pushed to /docs/cs-flywheel/1718459622-v1.md

Mia L: Perfect — I'll assemble everything and drop a public runbook link in #cs-templates. Target: publish internal runbook by EOD Fri. :rocket:

Omar R: +1

Jun Park: +1

Sofia A: +1 :thumbsup:

Mia L: Extra note — include a tiny "FAQ for renewals" section: if customer sees increased cost after enabling streaming, explain batching/TTL tradeoffs and show quick tuning knobs. Keep language customer-facing.
